newsitem.title: ISRAEL: King Hussein begins talks with Netanyahu.
newsitem.headline: King Hussein begins talks with Netanyahu.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein began talks on Sunday with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on breaking the Israel-PLO deadlock on a deal over Hebron and further Israeli pullbacks from the West Bank.

The king flew by helicopter to Tel Aviv from Gaza where he held talks with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat. Netanyahu welcomed the monarch outside the prime minister's office in Tel Aviv. Palestinian officials said King Hussein was carrying a compromise proposal on a new timeframe for the Israeli troop withdrawals from mostly rural areas of the West Bank.
